Definition: from G1537 and G3819; long ago, for a long while:--of a long time, of old.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, ékpalai is the word for of a long time, of old. In 2 Peter 2:3, the text says "whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, ékpalai, does its job quietly — of a long time, of old — and I leave it at that.
